newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's TRI sees rise in '96 profits.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's TRI sees rise in '96 profits.

text.p: Technology Resources Industries Bhd (TRI) expects pre-tax profit for the financial year ended December 31, 1996, to reach more than 300 million ringgit, the Star newspaper reported on Wednesday.
"I cannot reveal the exact figures at this juncture but the profits will be very much better than that for financial year 1995," TRI chairman Tajudin Ramli told the Star.
TRI registered a pre-tax profit of 238.34 million ringgit on turnover of 1.1 billion ringgit in 1995.
Some broking houses have scaled down their forecast for TRI's pre-tax profit for 1996 to around 270-285 million ringgit from more than 300 million.
This was partly due to worries over TRI's debt level and stiff competition in the company's cellular phone services business, analysts said.
Tajudin said TRI's bad debts in 1996 would be around the previous year's figure of 47 million ringgit.
